stem: A nurse participating in a hospital performance-improvement meeting reviews the CMS Hospital Value-Based Purchasing (VBP) Program. Which statement about the program is accurate?

options.A: The VBP payment adjustment is based only on the number of inpatient services the hospital bills
options.B: The VBP payment adjustment is based only on the hospital's annual operating margin
options.C: Hospital performance on specified quality and cost measures is linked to IPPS payment adjustments
options.D: The VBP payment adjustment is determined only by the hospital's number of licensed beds

rationale: CMS states that the Hospital VBP Program links hospital performance on quality and cost measures to payments under the Inpatient Prospective Payment System (IPPS) and rewards quality rather than simply the quantity of services provided. Therefore C is the best answer. A, B, and D each substitute a single volume, financial, or facility-size variable for the defined quality-and-cost performance framework used by the Hospital VBP Program.
educational_objective: Recognize the CMS Hospital VBP Program as a performance-improvement model in which specified quality and cost performance is linked to IPPS payment adjustments.
source_locator: Sections 'How does the Hospital VBP Program work?' and introductory program description: hospital performance on quality and cost measures is linked to IPPS; the program rewards quality rather than just quantity of services
source_claim_supported: Under the Hospital VBP Program, hospital performance on selected quality and cost measures is linked to IPPS payment adjustments; the program is designed to reward quality rather than merely quantity of services.
blueprint_source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
blueprint_locator: Appendix A, Management of Care > Performance Improvement (Quality Improvement), printed p.22 / PDF p.26: define performance improvement/quality assurance activities; participate in quality-improvement processes; evaluate the impact of performance-improvement measures on client care and resource use
blueprint_topic: Management of Care — Performance Improvement (Quality Improvement) and resource use
correction_summary: Reframed the item around the current CMS Hospital VBP definition; replaced the broad 'patient outcomes' wording with the directly supported quality-and-cost-measure framework; removed the finance-colleague narrative and rebuilt all distractors as parallel payment-determination alternatives; adjusted difficulty from hard to moderate; added an item-specific Educational Objective and exact CMS/NCSBN locators.
audit_findings: C is directly supported by the current CMS Hospital VBP page. A is wrong because VBP is not based only on billed service volume; B is wrong because annual operating margin is not the VBP performance basis; D is wrong because licensed-bed count is not the VBP performance basis. The stem explicitly asks about the CMS Hospital VBP Program, so other IPPS payment determinants cannot become second answers. Option grammar and length are sufficiently parallel, no answer-key cue is present, and no unsupported numeric precision remains.
